Delegate: Prisma generated client: suffix every per-model delegate interface shares (e.g. ArticleDelegate)
_count: Prisma Client: aggregate relation-count selection key
connect: Prisma Client: nested relation-write link operator
disconnect: Prisma Client: nested relation-write link operator
set: Prisma Client: nested relation-write link operator, for a to-many relation
update: Prisma Client: model delegate operation, and a nested relation-write operator
delete: Prisma Client: model delegate operation, and a nested relation-write operator
select: Prisma Client: query options key narrowing the fields a read returns
data: Prisma Client: query options key naming what a write sets
where: Prisma Client: query options key naming a call's filter
id: Prisma convention: the default primary key field name
include: Prisma Client: query options key adding relations to a read
create: Prisma Client: nested relation-write operator, and an upsert side
whole: suss: this pack's own ArgShape tag for an operation with no field-shaped payload (delete/deleteMany)
